id: # spec 单元格固定承载 canonical/claim/condition/fails_when/anchors；技能表头不扩展。state=green 只表示本轮 command 实跑绿，不等于 F3 证据齐。

# red_log 为本轮 Go -overlay 变异应用后的原始失败摘录；mutation 为可重放 unified diff；生产/tests 主树零写。leaf/require=-：通用门只接受任务行逐字命令与 TS 测试路径，Go 账本改由 command 命名锚＋mutation 击杀承担；原叶号与 require 符号见 mutations.md。forbid 逐字取 canonical fails_when。

spec: canonical=changes/01-bounds-contract/contracts/archive.md§六/C1；claim=开启归档且configured≥恒热结构下限、quiet可达时热卷字节有界于窗口工作量；condition=archive_root非空∧hot_log_max_bytes>0∧configured=hot_log_max_bytes+2*max_segment≥H∧cut正常；fails_when=quiet长期不可达则容忍超界并以hot_over_budget告警，非零不得宣称C1；anchors=α⁺TestHotLogPlateausAcrossGenerationsAndOldFactsStayReadable；α⁻TestQuietPointUnreachableToleratesOverBudget
command: go test ./assembly -count=1 -run '^(TestHotLogPlateausAcrossGenerationsAndOldFactsStayReadable|TestQuietPointUnreachableToleratesOverBudget)$' -v && printf 'Tests 2 passed (2)\n' || { rc=$?; printf 'Tests 1 failed (1)\n'; exit "$rc"; }

spec: canonical=changes/01-bounds-contract/contracts/archive.md§六/C2；claim=已归档事实按身份读返回原正文与原提交序，身份/顺序/授权不因搬迁改变；condition=archive_root非空、归档在线且读取方有scope授权；fails_when=缺失/损坏具名ErrArchiveMissing或ErrArchiveCorrupt，不得答不存在或静默丢召回；anchors=α⁺TestIdentityReadCrossesHotAndArchive/TestRecallGetCrossesArchive；α⁻TestArchiveMissingIsNamed/TestArchiveCorruptIsNamed/TestRecallCorruptionNotMissing/TestRecallGetPublicCorruption；αᶜrecall_get；TestCheckpointSliceReadsArchivedBodyByIdentity
